$meta.description: An `adminComputer` belongs to Greybel's interpreter, not to the game: `adminNetwork.computer` returns one for a computer's LAN address, in Greybel's simulated world only. Its methods give access to that computer and change it, such as opening a shell without a password or adding NPCs. The `classID` used for this object is `"adminComputer"`.

shell.description: Returns a `shell` on this computer as `user`, without a password, or `null` when the computer or the user doesn't exist. Returns `null` when called on anything but an `adminComputer`.

login.description: Opens a session for `user` on this computer, so the active-user checks of exploits and `netSession` see them. Returns `1` when it was opened, otherwise `0`. Returns `null` when called on anything but an `adminComputer`.

add_npc.description: Adds an NPC who logs in to this computer as `user`, first after `delay` seconds, named `name`. Returns the NPC's id, or `null` when it couldn't be added. Returns `null` when called on anything but an `adminComputer`.

npc_login.description: Makes the NPC `user` of this computer log in to their SSH or FTP service, as the social-engineering mail does in the game: their credentials pass the sniffers on the way, and they stay logged in for an hour. Returns `1` when they logged in, otherwise `0`. Returns `null` when called on anything but an `adminComputer`.

add_net_card.description: Adds a network card to this computer: Wi-Fi when `wifi` is truthy, otherwise Ethernet, with monitor mode when `monitorSupport` is truthy. Returns `1` when it was added, otherwise `0`. Returns `null` when called on anything but an `adminComputer`.

add_smart_appliance.description: Turns this computer into a smart appliance. Every key of `options` is optional: `model` (default `"FR/unknown"`), `power`, `temperature` and `overrideEnabled` (default `1`). Returns `1` when it was changed, otherwise `0`. Options that aren't a map, or keys of the wrong type, raise `add_smart_appliance: Invalid arguments`. Returns `null` when called on anything but an `adminComputer`.

set_library_version.description: Sets the version of the library at `path` on this computer, such as `"1.0.2"`. Returns `1` when it was changed, otherwise `0`. Returns `null` when called on anything but an `adminComputer`.

set_port_library_version.description: Sets the version of the library of the service on this computer's `port`. Returns `1` when it was changed, otherwise `0`. Returns `null` when called on anything but an `adminComputer`.

service_records.description: Returns the records of this computer's records `service`, `"criminals"`, `"employees"` or `"students"`, as JSON, as the game's records viewer shows them. Returns `null` when the computer doesn't run that service. Returns `null` when called on anything but an `adminComputer`.

update_service_record.description: Replaces the record of the same person in this computer's records `service` (`"criminals"`, `"employees"` or `"students"`) with the JSON `record`, as the game's records viewer does. Returns an empty `string` on success, otherwise the viewer's error. Returns `null` when called on anything but an `adminComputer`.

access_cctv.description: Opens this camera's feed with `password`, as the game's camera website does. Returns `null` when the camera asks for a password, the feed as JSON when the password is right (the camera's LAN address and the people of its network), or why it can't be opened as a `string`. Returns `null` when called on anything but an `adminComputer`.

install_smartphone_adb.description: Installs the ADB service on this smartphone. Returns `1` when it was installed, otherwise `0`. Returns `null` when called on anything but an `adminComputer`.
